faq_heading: New construction in Port Moody Centre: your questions answered

faq.q: What have condos in Port Moody Centre sold for?
faq.a: 195 condos sold in Port Moody Centre at a median of $705,000, with the middle half between $602,000 and $797,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: In Port Moody Centre, houses were quickest at 21 days at a median, and townhomes slowest at 26 days.

faq.q: Which homes in Port Moody Centre are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Port Moody Centre, townhomes had the newest median build year, 2012.

blocks.text: What you see above is a live MLS® search for Port Moody Centre: active houses, townhomes and condos with an age of 0 or less, so this year's completions and homes still being built. items.t: In Port Moody Centre, houses sold at a median of $1,390,000 across 11 sales, and the middle half closed between $1,292,500 and $1,915,000. The median house sat 21 days and sold for 96.0% of list.
Port Moody Centre: 31 townhomes sold at a median of $1,112,000, with the middle half between $954,500 and $1,181,750. The median townhome took 26 days to sell and closed at 97.9% of list.

195 condos sold in Port Moody Centre at a median of $705,000 (middle half $602,000 to $797,000). A typical condo in Port Moody Centre spent 26 days on the market and closed at 97.7% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Port Moody Centre compares with the rest of Port Moody

items.t: Houses in Port Moody Centre have the lowest median of the 8 Port Moody sub-areas, $1,390,000, below College Park PM at $1,640,850; the highest is Anmore at $2,725,000.

Townhomes in Port Moody Centre have the third highest median of 5 Port Moody sub-areas, $1,112,000. North Shore Pt Moody is lowest at $755,000 and Heritage Mountain highest at $1,320,000. College Park PM ($829,000) sits just below and Heritage Woods PM ($1,158,000) sits just above.

Of 3 Port Moody sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Port Moody Centre ranks second lowest at $705,000; the range is $487,500 (College Park PM) to $735,000 (North Shore Pt Moody). College Park PM ($487,500) sits just below and North Shore Pt Moody ($735,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, townhomes are the newest homes selling in Port Moody Centre (median 2012) and houses the oldest (median 1969), a gap of 43 years.
